name: page-header-split
title: Split page header
description: An inner-page opening in two columns: the title set very large on the left, the lede, up to four facts and one action on the right.
docs: Pass eyebrow, title and lede, up to four facts ({ label, value }, a description list whose labels never wrap) and one action. titleAs defaults to h1 because this header opens an inner page; use h2 under another heading or in a preview. children go in a slot under the closing hairline: tabs, a filter row, a search field. Below lg the columns stack with the title first. The facts follow the width of their column, not of the window: four share a row once their column is 448px wide, three once it is 384px, and until then they keep two to a row, so a value never wraps or runs into its neighbour. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
